Roasted Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Rice Bake🔥598 cals 62g protein 21g fat 38g carbs Ingredients: This makes 4 meals 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed 1 cup dry jasmine rice (185g) 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block (8oz) reduced-fat cream cheese ½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese  1 whole garlic bulb 1 tsp olive oil Fresh parsley for garnish Seasoning blend: 2 tsp garlic powder 2 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°. In a 9×13 baking dish, add your uncooked jasmine rice and chicken broth. Stir everything together and spread the rice evenly across the bottom. 2. In a large bowl, add your cubed chicken breast along with the entire seasoning blend. Toss thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated. 3. Place your seasoned chicken evenly on top of the rice mixture, keeping the tops of the chicken exposed. Slice the top off your whole garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Drizzle with olive oil and place it cut-side up alongside the chicken. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil. 4. Bake for 40–50 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. If the rice is still firm, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking until tender. 5. Remove the foil and squeeze the softened garlic cloves into the rice. Add your reduced-fat cream cheese and grated parmesan cheese, then mix everything into the hot rice until melted and creamy 6. Return to the oven uncovered for another 5–8 minutes. For a golden finish, broil for the final 1–2 minutes, watching closely. Garnish with fresh parsley, divide evenly into 6 meals, and enjoy! CHIPOTLE HONEY CHICKEN BOWLS CHICKEN 3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo* ¼ cup honey + more to drizzle ¼ cup olive oil + juice of 2 limes 1 Tbsp EACH garlic powder, onion powder + paprika 2 tsp EACH chili powder, cumin + oregano 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1 tsp black pepper Add everything to chicken, toss well + marinate. Spread on a sheet pan, drizzle with a little more honey + bake at 425°F for 20–25 min or until 165°F. Broil briefly at the end if you want more char. *Spicy: use the whole can, peppers + sauce. Mild: use the adobo sauce but leave out the peppers. CILANTRO-LIME RICE 3 cups long-grain rice + ¾–1 cup warm chicken broth + ½ cup cilantro + juice of 2 limes + 2 Tbsp olive oil + salt. Cook rice; while HOT, add cilantro, lime, oil + salt, then slowly add broth while fluffing until absorbed. CORN SALSA 3 cups corn (canned or frozen) + 1 diced jalapeño + ½ diced red onion + ½ bunch chopped cilantro + juice 1–2 limes + S&P. Mix. BLACK BEANS 2 cans black beans + 1 tsp cumin + salt + splash chicken broth. Warm together. PICO 4 tomatoes + ½ red onion + ½ bunch cilantro, all diced + juice 1–2 limes + salt. Mix. SHEET-PAN BEEF KEBABS 3 lb ground beef 1 large white onion + 1 red bell pepper 6 garlic cloves + 1 bunch parsley 2 Tbsp paprika + 1 Tbsp cumin 2 tsp EACH coriander + turmeric 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp cinnamon (optional) Food-process onion, pepper, garlic + parsley until finely chopped. Transfer to cheesecloth + squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Add to beef with all spices + hand mix. Press evenly onto a sheet pan. Use a bench scraper to make deep kebab-style rows as shown in the video. Bake at 425°F for ~15 min, carefully drain excess liquid/fat, then broil 3–5 min until browned. ROASTED PEPPERS + ONIONS 2 red + 2 yellow bell peppers + 2 red onions + 1 bunch scallions + 2 tsp EACH paprika + cumin + olive oil + S&P. Slice, toss + roast at 425°F for 20–25 min until tender + charred. QUICK TZATZIKI 2 cups Greek yogurt + 1 grated cucumber + 1 grated garlic clove + juice 1 lemon + ¼ cup dill + salt. Mix. Brush pita with olive oil + grill until lightly charred. Fill with tzatziki, beef kebab + roasted peppers and onions. MAPLE SWEET POTATOES 6 sweet potatoes, halved + a little olive oil + maple syrup. Rub all over, place CUT-SIDE DOWN + roast at 425°F until tender + deeply caramelized. BROCCOLI Broccoli florets + olive oil + garlic powder + S&P. They are fooling you to get your 💵  Every collagen cream, serum, and moisturizer on the market? A waste of your money.  Collagen is a protein molecule too large to penetrate the skin barrier, it just sits on top and does nothing. The only way collagen actually works is from the inside out. Here’s what the science says: A double-blind trial (2025) found just 2.5g/day of collagen peptides reduced wrinkles and improved elasticity in 4 weeks. A meta-analysis of 26 clinical trials confirmed it works, but only after 8+ weeks of consistent use. And a 2024 RCT found 12 weeks of daily collagen caused a 44% decrease in collagen breakdown, 22% more elasticity, 13% more hydration, AND a 27% increase in hair growth. The catch? It has to be hydrolyzed collagen peptides. Not the stuff in your moisturizer. Save this. Creamy Cajun Chicken 🔥 Ingredients For the chicken: * Chicken breasts * Salt * Black pepper * Garlic powder * Cajun seasoning For the Cajun sauce: * Butter * Chopped onion * Cherry tomatoes * Red bell pepper * Minced garlic * Tomato paste * Salt & black pepper * Thyme * Oregano * Cajun seasoning * Chicken broth * Heavy cream Cooking Instructions 1. Season the chicken: Pat the chicken breasts dry and season both sides with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and Cajun seasoning. 2. Cook the chicken: Heat a little oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken on both sides until golden brown and fully cooked (165°F internal temperature). DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.  6. Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven. 7. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

LAZY CINNAMON ROLL APPLE PIE 🍏🥧✨ This recipe has gone viral every time I’ve shared it over the years, it’s one of those warm, cozy classics that makes its way onto our table every holiday. Perfect for Thanksgiving, family get-togethers, or an easy Christmas morning breakfast! You can even prep it the night before and pop it in the oven the next morning! 🎄 Ingredients 🍏  1 can refrigerated cinnamon rolls (with icing) 1 can apple pie filling (21 oz) ¼ cup heavy cream 4 tbsp melted butter ½ cup brown sugar ½ cup all-purpose flour ½ tsp cinnamon DIRECTIONS🥧 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F. Pour the heavy cream into the bottom of a greased pie dish or baking dish. 2. Cut your cinnamon rolls into quarters and spread them evenly over the heavy cream. Spoon the apple pie filling right on top. 3. In a bowl, mix the melted butter, brown sugar, flour, and cinnamon until you get a crumbly, wet sand texture. Sprinkle evenly over the apples. 4. Bake for 30–35 minutes, or until golden brown and the cinnamon rolls are cooked through. Let cool slightly before drizzling with the icing from the cinnamon roll package! Serve warm with vanilla ice cream if you want to make it extra delicious! 🤎 TIP: You can use homemade apple pie filling or swap in your favorite canned pie filling! To prep ahead, assemble everything, cover, and refrigerate overnight, then bake fresh in the morning. You may need a few extra minutes in the oven! #easyrecipes #quickrecipe #cinnamonrolls #floridablogger #tastewithnicki

Lastly add garlic and cook until translucent for about 30 seconds  - Add 2 tbsp of flour  - Add about 2-3 tbsp of tomato paste and cook for about 1-2 minute  - Add wine and stir and cook for about 3-4 minutes occasionally until it’s reduced about half way  - Add beef broth  - Add seasonings listed above,  the kinder packet, beef bouillon cube, worcestershire sauce and stirr  - Add the chuck and top with the fresh parsley,  thyme, bayl leaves and cover and place in oven - Add in oven and cook for about 2 hours   - After 2  hours remove from oven and add the carrots, potatoes and give it a slight stir  -  Place back in oven for about 1 hour until fully cooked and veggies are tender  - Lastly, serve and enjoy!

If you need an easy dinner idea tonight, make these sheet pan chicken fajitas.  One of the easiest dinners ever, so flavorful, so delicious, and dinner is on the table in about 30 minutes. Everyone loved it. Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. I skipped parchment paper because I wanted the chicken and vegetables to get direct heat from the pan for extra flavor and color. Slice the onion and peppers into strips and add them to the pan. Season with all the spices, drizzle with oil, and toss everything together really well. Spread into an even layer and bake in a preheated 425°F oven for 20–25 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the guacamole. Mash the avocados and mix with the onion, Serrano chili, cilantro, lime juice, and salt. Give the chicken and vegetables a quick toss, then broil for another 2–3 minutes until slightly charred. Serve in warm tortillas with fresh guacamole, cilantro, and an extra squeeze of lime. #sivanskitchen #sheetpan #fajita #chicken #easyrecipe

Artist Casey Curran creates kinetic sculptures that combine mechanical systems with forms inspired by plants and natural structures. In this prototype, layers of delicate petals are connected so that a single mechanical action produces a rippling movement across the entire structure. Instead of every element moving independently, the motion travels through the sculpture like a wave. This type of movement is central to Curran’s practice. Using motors, wires, cranks and carefully engineered mechanisms, he creates artificial flowers and organisms that bloom, flutter and contract. Creamy lemon chicken makes a quick easy and delicious dinner perfect for those busy nights. 1 tsp salt 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp pepper  1/4 tsp paprika 1/2 tsp Italian seasoning  2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breast 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour  1/2 cup shredded Parm 4 cloves crushed garlic 2 tbs freshly squeezed lemon juice  1 tbs lemon zest 1 tbs olive oil 4 tbs butter 1 cup heavy whipping cream  1 cup water For the sauce: I/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp salt Season chicken breast with seasoning on both sides then brown in a pan over high heat in olive oil. Remove the chicken from the pan. In the same pan, add butter and one melted, add garlic. Sauté for a minute and then add in flour and sauté an additional minute. Add in water, lemon juice, and heavy cream. Once the sauce comes together, add in lemon zest, Parmesan cheese and salt and pepper. Stir until the cheese is fully melted then add the chicken back to the pan. Cover with the lid and simmer for five minutes. Spoon the sauce over the chicken. videos.caption: COWBOY BUTTER CHICKEN ALFREDO 🤠🧈🍝  If you know me, you know I LOVE anything cowboy butter! This was a 10/10!! Creamy, cheesy, packed with SO much flavor, and ready in under 30 minutes!  INGREDIENTS: * 2–3 chicken breasts, cubed * 12 oz pasta * 1 tbsp olive oil @getgraza  *4 tbsp butter * 1½ cups heavy whipping cream (+ a splash more if needed) * 1 cup mozzarella cheese * ½ cup parmesan cheese * ½ cup pepper jack cheese * 1 tbsp Dijon mustard SEASONINGS (ALL TO TASTE): * Kinder’s Cowboy Butter Seasoning @Kinder's Flavors *Garlic powder * Onion powder * Italian seasoning * Paprika * Slap Ya Mama @Slap Ya Mama  * Salt & pepper INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions. 2. Season cubed chicken with all seasonings. Cook in olive oil until golden and fully cooked (165°F).   3. Transfer chicken to a plate. Lower heat to medium-low and melt butter in the same skillet. Add the same seasonings and Dijon mustard. 4. Pour in heavy cream and simmer for 2–3 minutes. 5. Sprinkle in mozzarella, parmesan, and pepper jack. Stir until creamy, adding another splash of heavy cream if needed. 6. Add pasta and chicken back in, toss until coated, and serve! I didn’t measure my seasonings, just added everything to taste!  SAVE this easy chicken pasta recipe for your next weeknight dinner!! 🤍 #CowboyButterChicken #ChickenAlfredoRecipe #EasyDinnerIdeas #30MinuteMeals #ChickenPastaRecipes

This is dinner on easy mode! 🍲 Stick of Butter Chicken and Rice will be your best friend in the kitchen when you don’t feel like spending hours over the stovetop! Want to make it later? Save this recipe in @myrecipes so it's ready when you are. Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Stir rice, French onion soup, beef consomme, and portobello mushrooms together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 3/4 cup of the cheese and add butter pieces on top. Season chicken evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika and place on top of cheese and butter. Top with remaining cheese and cover dish with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until top is golden brown, liquid has been absorbed into the rice, and chicken is cooked through, about 20 more minutes. Sprinkle with fresh parsley if desired. Inspiration: @melissajorealrecipes 🧑‍🍳: @nicolemcmom #easydinners #dinnerideas #butter #chicken #chickenandrice

One Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken Bake🔥410 cals 37g protein 11g fat 40g carbs Cookbook in bio 🔗 Ingredients: this makes 6 meals 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 ½ cups jasmine rice, uncooked 3 cups chicken broth, warmed 1 medium yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 1 ½ cups cherry tomatoes, halved 2 cups baby spinach, roughly chopped 4 cloves garlic, minced 50g freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 tsp Italian seasoning 1 ½ tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder ¾ tsp smoked paprika ¾ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ tsp red pepper flakes (optional) ¼ cup fresh parsley, finely chopped Directions 1. Sticky Chicken & Garlic Noodles  This is an  easy weeknight dinner you can make with spaghetti or ramen noodles. I got this from my friend @mamasdownsouthkitchen 😊 Ingredients Chicken and vegetables: 1½ lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, diced 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder ½ tsp black pepper 1 tbsp chili crunch (optional)  1 tsp sesame oil  2 tbsp oil (for cooking)  2 bell peppers, diced 1 onion, diced Sticky garlic sauce: ½ cup soy sauce (used reduced if you are sensitive to salt)  2 tbsp minced garlic ¼ cup honey 3 tbsp hoisin sauce 2 tbsp cornstarch Noodles: 12 oz spaghetti or 4–5 packs of ramen noodles, seasoning packets discarded Up to 1 cup reserved noodle cooking water Instructions 1. Toss the diced chicken with the garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, sesame oil, and chili crunch. Set a pot of water on the stove to boil. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the seasoned chicken and let it sear. 3. While the chicken sears, whisk together the soy sauce, honey, hoisin sauce, minced garlic, and cornstarch until smooth. 4. Add the diced bell peppers and onion to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables begin to soften and the chicken is cooked through. 5. Cook the noodles according to the package directions. Reserve some of the cooking water before draining. 6. Stir the minced garlic into the skillet and cook for about 1 minute, until fragrant. Give the sauce another whisk, pour it into the skillet, and stir until it bubbles and thickens. Add the reserved noodle water a splash at a time until the sauce reaches your desired consistency. 7. Add the drained noodles to the skillet and toss until everything is coated in the sticky garlic sauce. Serve warm and enjoy! #easyrecipe #easydinner #dinnerideas #onepotmeals #chickenrecipe

This recipe went VIRAL for a reason… and I’m convinced it’s the BEST Sunday dinner you’ll ever make! 🤤👏🏼 I’ve made these slow-roasted chicken thighs for 9 Sundays in a row, and my family STILL isn’t tired of them! 😂 Perfectly seasoned, melt-in-your-mouth tender, and packed with SO much flavor! It’s one of those meals that looks impressive but is ridiculously easy to make! Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 sliced onion (I use less!) • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish and generously season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika & Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and add sliced onions. 3. Pour in 2 cups of chicken broth and add fresh thyme. 4. Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour. 5. Remove thyme and pour the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir into the liquid. 6. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 7. Bake UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes, until the chicken is beautifully browned and the gravy thickens!  And YES, I promise the broth doesn’t wash off all that seasoning. 😂 Just trust the process! All credit to @allyssainthekitchen for this incredible recipe! 🤎 SAVE THIS ONE because I promise you’ll be making it again and again! #SundayDinner #ChickenThighs #EasyDinnerIdeas #HomeCooking #DinnerRecipes

YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

Macros (Per Bowl - Makes 4) Calories — 500 Protein — 58g Carbs — 52g Fat — 5g Ingredients 🥣 2 lb or 32oz chicken breast, Raw 4 medium bell peppers (color doesn’t matter) 2 packets of  Fajita seasoning 5-second spray or ~5g avocado oil spray 2 1/2 cups or 600g cooked jasmine rice High Protein Sauce 💪 1/2 cup or 100g nonfat plain Greek yogurt 2 tbsp or 25g sriracha 1/2 lime, juiced Garlic powder How to make: 🧑‍🍳 1️⃣ Start by getting your rice cooking in a rice cooker or pot. 2️⃣ Dice your chicken and bell peppers, then add everything to a bowl with your fajita seasoning and mix until evenly coated. 3️⃣ Lightly spray your air fryer basket with avocado oil spray, add your chicken and peppers, and air fry at 400°F (200C) for about 20 minutes, tossing halfway through, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (75°C). 4️⃣ While that cooks, make your high-protein sauce by mixing together the Greek yogurt, sriracha, lime juice and garlic powder. 5️⃣ Once everything is cooked, evenly divide your rice, chicken and peppers between 4 meal prep containers and finish each one with your high-protein sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. An aquarium’s filter does far more than keep the water looking clean. It continuously removes waste, circulates oxygen, and provides a home for beneficial bacteria that break down harmful toxins produced by fish and uneaten food. Without proper filtration, ammonia and other toxic compounds can quickly build up, turning a healthy aquarium into a dangerous environment for its inhabitants. A good filtration system helps maintain water quality, stabilize the ecosystem, and keep fish healthy over the long term. While decorations and lighting may catch the eye, the filter is the unseen engine that keeps the entire aquarium alive.

Who needs a bun when the cheese does all the work? 🤯 These crispy chicken taco sandwiches seriously taste like a guilty pleasure, but they’re packed with protein! Huge shoutout to @Tasty Shreds for the inspiration! 🙌 Crispy High-Protein Chicken Taco Sandwiches Makes: 2 servings Ingredients: * 4 Just Bare Lightly Breaded Chicken Breast Strips * 4 slices turkey bacon, cooked and chopped * 90g Trader Joe’s Lite Shredded Mozzarella * 30g Sargento Reduced Fat Mozzarella * Very light drizzle of oil (about 1 tsp total or less) * Seasoning of choice (I used Fire & Smoke Society Honey Garlic Seasoning) Optional Toppings: * Shredded lettuce * Tomato slices * Pickled jalapeños * Protein ranch (plain nonfat Greek yogurt mixed with ranch seasoning) * Fresh chives Instructions 1. Cook the chicken strips according to the package directions, then chop into bite-sized pieces. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and lightly drizzle with oil. 3. Divide the chicken into two taco shell-shaped rounds, about the size of a taco shell. 4. Top each with 2 slices of chopped turkey bacon. 5. Mix both cheeses together and divide evenly over the chicken. 6. Season to your liking. (I used Fire & Smoke Society Honey Garlic Seasoning.) 7. Bake at 375°F for about 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and just starting to turn golden. Be careful not to overbake or the cheese will become too crisp to fold. 8. Let cool for 2–3 minutes until the cheese firms up slightly, then carefully peel each shell away from the parchment. It should still be flexible enough to fold. 9. Carefully fold into taco shapes, then fill with shredded lettuce, tomato, pickled jalapeños, protein ranch, and a generous sprinkle of fresh chives. Calories & Macros (Per Serving) * Calories: ~400 * Protein: ~45g * Carbohydrates: ~18g * Fat: ~17g #HighProtein #HealthyRecipes #EasyDinner #LowCalorieMeals #MadeByMegRecipes

🍫 Knock Me Naked Cake A rich, chocolatey Butterfinger poke cake loaded with sweetened condensed milk, Cool Whip, and caramel! Ingredients 1 box Duncan Hines Devil’s Food Cake Mix 4 eggs 1 cup milk 1 stick butter, melted 1 can sweetened condensed milk 1 bag fun-size Butterfinger candy bars, crushed 2 containers Cool Whip Caramel sauce, for drizzling Instructions 1. Prepare the cake: Preheat your oven to 350°F. Mix together the cake mix, eggs, milk, and melted butter until well combined. Pour into a greased 9×13-inch baking dish. 2. Bake: Bake for 29–30 minutes, depending on your oven, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. 3. Poke & pour: While the cake is still warm, poke holes all over the top. Pour the entire can of sweetened condensed milk evenly over the cake, allowing it to soak into the holes. 4. Add the Butterfingers: Crush the entire bag of fun-size Butterfinger candy bars. Sprinkle half of the crushed candy over the cake and save the remaining half for topping. 5. Cool completely: Allow the cake to cool completely before adding the topping. 6. Finish it off: Spread both containers of Cool Whip evenly over the cake. Sprinkle the remaining crushed Butterfingers on top and finish with a generous drizzle of caramel sauce. 7. Refrigerate & serve: Cover and store the cake in the refrigerator until ready to serve. Keep any leftovers refrigerated. 🤎 Kalyn’s Tip: This cake is delicious served cold! Give it time to chill so all that sweetened condensed milk can soak into the chocolate cake. #KnockMeNakedCake #ButterfingerCake #PokeCake #SouthernDesserts #EasyDessert

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

🥩🍲 Slow Cooker Garlic Butter Beef & Onion Gravy This tender, juicy slow-cooked beef is the ultimate comfort food! Thick, beautifully browned pieces of beef simmer low and slow in a rich, savory garlic butter gravy with sweet caramelized onions. Every piece is coated in a delicious, glossy sauce that makes this dish absolutely irresistible. The slow cooking process allows the beef to soak up all those incredible flavors until it's fork-tender and incredibly juicy. It's the kind of hearty, homemade dinner that fills the kitchen with an amazing aroma and brings everyone to the table. ❤️ 🥘 Ingredients 2 lbs beef chuck steak or boneless beef roast, sliced into thick pieces 2 large onions, sliced 4 cloves garlic, minced 3 tbsp butter 2 cups beef broth 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp tomato paste 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp black pepper Salt to taste 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water (optional) 👩‍🍳 Instructions Season the beef with salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder. Heat a skillet with a little oil and sear the beef on both sides until nicely browned. Place sliced onions and minced garlic in the slow cooker. Arrange the browned beef over the onions. Mix beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, and tomato paste. Pour over the beef. Add butter on top, cover, and cook on LOW for 7–8 hours or HIGH for 4–5 hours, until fork-tender. If desired, thicken the gravy with the cornstarch mixture during the final 20–30 minutes. Spoon that rich, flavorful onion gravy over the beef and serve hot! 😍 Perfect with creamy mashed potatoes, buttery rice, or warm dinner rolls to soak up every drop of that delicious gravy! Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8.  Remove and layer the sauced chicken on top, then add more cheese. 9.  Broil 3-4 min until the second layer melts. Remove.  10.  Top with pickles, then drizzle ranch over the top. 11. Better than the restaurant version and it only takes 30 minutes in one pot! 🍲✨ Creamy, comforting, and loaded with pillowy gnocchi. Who are you making this for? Recipe below 👇🏼    Ingredients  2 chicken breasts ( cut into small cubes) 16 oz Gnocchi potato pasta 3 celery stalks (chopped) 1/4 onion (chopped) 1 cup shredded carrots Handful spinach (what your hand can grab) 1/4 cup all purpose flour (thickens the sauce) 2 cups of heavy whipping cream  2 cups of milk 3 cups of chicken broth  1 garlic clove ( finely chopped)or minced garlic  Smoked paprika seasoning  Black pepper  Garlic salt  Italian seasoning  Thyme seasoning  Montreal chicken seasoning  Olive oil  4 tbsp butter Steps  1. Season the chicken with all seasoning mentioned above measure with your heart and drizzle olive oil and mix well. In a hot pot cook your chicken till done. Remove chicken and set aside.  2. Add butter, diced onion sear till it gets translucent then add chopped celery and sear for about 2 minutes, add the chopped garlic clove and mix it for about a minute go ahead and add shredded carrots, cook for a minute then add the flour and stir very well.  3. Add chicken broth,heavy whipping cream, and milk, add the chicken back in and season with Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, black pepper and a small dash of thyme (it’s optional you don’t have to add it) since thyme it has a strong flavor add the spinach and mix well. Bring it to a boil.  4. Once it comes to a boil add gnocchi pasta and break apart since it does intend to stick together stir well and cover and cook for 5 to 6 minutes. Gnocchi pasta does cook up quickly. Turn off the heat and let it cover for about 3 minutes to get that thicker sauce texture.  5. Serve on a bowl top with Parmesan cheese and sprinkle red chili flakes if desired. Pair with garlic bread and enjoy! 😉 #cozyrecipes  #comfortfood #chickengnocchisoup #soupseason #easyweeknightmeals

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

We know what you're making this week...🤭🌮 Want to make this later? Save it on @myrecipes so it's ready when you are. Ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breast, cut in ¾” inch pieces 1/2 cup finely chopped onion 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon kosher salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper 3/4 teaspoon chili powder 1/2 teaspoon cumin 1 cup green enchilada sauce or tomatillo salsa, divided 1 can pinto beans, drained 2 tablespoons melted butter 8 6-inch flour tortillas 2 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese 1/2 cup sour cream Shredded lettuce and any other desired toppings Directions: Preheat oven to 375. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season chicken pieces well with garlic powder, salt, pepper, chili powder and cumin. Add chicken to hot skillet and cook, undisturbed until browned and easily releases from the pan, 3-4 minutes. Add onion and stir chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, 3 more minutes. Add 2/3 cup salsa and beans and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat slightly and cook, stirring occasionally until slightly thickened and creamy, about 5 minutes. Brush sides and bottom of an 11 x 7 baking pan or baking dish with butter. Working with 1 tortilla at a time, use remaining butter to brush one side of each tortilla and place in dish. Place about 1 tablespoons of cheese in bottom of the tortilla and top with about 1/3 cup filling and a couple more tablespoons of cheese. Fold tortilla up like a taco and place it against the edge of the pan. Place a second buttered tortilla against the next one and top with cheese and filling. Fold in half and repeat with remaining tortillas, filling and cheese to fill the baking dish with side by side tacos. Top with any remaining cheese. Bake 20-25 minutes or until tops of each tortilla are golden brown and toasted and cheese is melted and bubbly. Meanwhile, stir together remaining salsa with sour cream until well combined. Top with lettuce just before serving and serve topped with sour cream sauce. ✨ Recipe Inspiration: @iramsfoodstory 🎥: Nicole @nicolesperfectbite #chicken #tacos #baking #dinner

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Full of flavor, nutrients, texture, omg. ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice 1 cup beef bone broth 1/3 cup half & half ground beef  1 garlic clove, minced soy sauce, to taste paprika oregano cilantro black pepper tomato paste mustard (IMPORTANT) lemon  green onions + sesame seeds for topping how to make it: 1. Brown the ground beef in a skillet until fully cooked. Add the seasonings on top along with soy sauce and mustard, add tomato paste gradually. 2. Once fully cooked, transfer it to a bowl. 3. Top with the ground beef, a fried or soft-boiled egg, green onions and sesame seeds. 5. ✨ Cheesy Meat-Stuffed Breakfast Biscuits ✨ A delicious, flaky, and cheese-packed comfort food recipe featuring golden-brown biscuits stuffed with savory ground meat and melted cheese. 🍴 Ingredients: - 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough or homemade biscuit dough - 1 lb ground beef or sausage, cooked and seasoned - 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tbsp melted butter - 1 tsp garlic powder - Fresh parsley, finely chopped for garnish - Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste 👩🏽‍🍳 Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Cook the ground meat in a skillet with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until fully browned, then drain excess fat. 3. Separate the biscuit dough, flatten each piece slightly, and place a spoonful of cooked meat and a generous amount of shredded cheese in the center. 4. Fold the dough securely around the filling to form stuffed biscuit balls or rounds, pinching the edges to seal. 5. Arrange the stuffed biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. 6. Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle a little extra cheese or parsley on top. 7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and cooked through. 8. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve warm. 📝 Notes: These flaky, cheese-stuffed biscuits make the ultimate grab-and-go breakfast, packed with rich flavor in every single bite. #BreakfastBiscuits #StuffedBiscuits #CheeseLovers #ComfortFood #SavoryBaking

Cozy Dinner Idea 🤎 Creamy Chicken Marsala 🍄 INGREDIENTS For the Chicken: • 2 large chicken breasts, sliced horizontally into 4 cutlets • Kinder’s Grilled Chicken Seasoning • Salt, to taste • ½ cup all-purpose flour • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp unsalted butter For the Marsala Sauce: • 8 oz baby bella mushrooms, sliced • 1 shallot, finely diced • 3–4 garlic cloves, minced • ¾ cup Marsala cooking wine • ¾ cup chicken broth • ½ cup heavy cream • 3–4 sprigs fresh thyme • Salt & black pepper, to taste • 1 tbsp butter (optional, for finishing) • Fresh parsley, for garnish INSTRUCTIONS 1. Season chicken cutlets on both sides with salt and Kinder’s Grilled Chicken Seasoning. Lightly coat each piece in flour, shaking off any excess. 2. Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden brown. Remove and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add sliced mushrooms to the remaining butter, oil, and chicken drippings. Sauté for 5–7 minutes until golden brown. 4. Add diced shallots and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in minced garlic and fresh thyme, cooking for another 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in Marsala cooking wine, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the skillet. Simmer for 3–5 minutes until reduced by half. 6. Add chicken broth and simmer for another 3–4 minutes. Reduce heat to medium-low, stir in heavy cream, and let the sauce gently simmer until slightly thickened. 7. Return chicken and any juices to the skillet. Spoon the creamy mushroom sauce over the chicken and simmer for 3–5 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally. 8. Remove thyme stems, stir in a tablespoon of butter if desired for a silky finish, and garnish with fresh parsley. #ChickenMarsala #DinnerIdeas #EasyDinnerRecipes #QuickDinner #CozyDinner

Another new recipe for me today and another winner!  #tiktokthanksgivingcontest #thanksgivingdessert #gingerbread  Gingerbread Brownies with Gingerbread Ermine Frosting Original recipe by I Am Baker. Note: The only changes I made to the original recipe were using salted butter instead of unsalted butter and increasing the salt to 1 teaspoon in the brownies. Gingerbread Brownies Ingredients 1 cup (2 sticks) salted butter, melted 1 1/2 cups light brown sugar, packed 2 large eggs, room temperature  2 tablespoons molasses 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour 1 tablespoon ground ginger 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 teaspoon salt Gingerbread Ermine Frosting Ingredients 1 cup whole milk 5 tablespoons all-purpose flour 1 cup (2 sticks) salted butter, room temperature 1 cup light brown sugar, packed 1 teaspoon gingerbread spice mix (recipe below) 1 teaspoon vanilla extract Directions Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 9x9-inch baking dish with parchment paper and set aside. In a large bowl, mix melted butter and brown sugar together until well combined. Add eggs, molasses and vanilla and mix until smooth. In a separate bowl, whisk flour, ginger, cinnamon, baking powder and salt together. Gradually add dry ingredients to wet ingredients and mix until fully combined. Spread batter evenly into prepared baking dish. Bake for 28-33 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is no longer jiggly. Allow brownies to cool completely before frosting. While brownies are cooling, make the frosting. In a medium saucepan over medium heat, whisk milk and flour together. Cook for 3-5 minutes, whisking constantly, until mixture is smooth and thick like pudding. Remove from heat and allow to cool completely to room temperature. Press plastic wrap directly onto the surface to prevent a skin from forming. In a large bowl, cream softened butter and brown sugar together for 2-3 minutes until light and fluffy. Scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed. Add cooled milk mixture and gingerbread spice mix. Beat on medium-high speed for 2-3 minutes until light and fluffy. Switch to a whisk attachment, add vanilla and whip on high for 7-8 minutes until frosting is smooth and creamy. Spread frosting evenly over completely cooled brownies. Slice and serve! Homemade Gingerbread Spice Mix 3 tablespoons ground cinnamon 2 tablespoons ground ginger 1 tablespoon ground nutmeg 1 teaspoon ground allspice 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom (optional)

Cut your cucumbers into 1 inch pieces and crush them with a mallet 2. In a bowl, add your cucumbers and salt and set aside for 10 minutes. 3. Drain all excess liquid, rise your cucumbers with water, pat them dry with a paper towel, and in a new bowl add rice vinegar, minced, garlic, sesame oil, sesame seeds, soy sauce, brown sugar, and gochugaru and mix well to make your spicy cucumber kimchi 4. Season your chicken evenly with salt, pepper, and cornstarch 5. In a bowl, mix together soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, minced garlic, and minced ginger to make your glaze 6. In a pan on medium hear coated with spray oil, cook your chicken until golden brown, then flip and cook until both sides are golden brown with a crispy crust 7. Lower the heat to low and pour your glaze on top of the chicken and let it sit for 1 minute 8. In a meal prep container, add half your cooked rice, half your chicken, half your cucumber kimchi salad, and top it off with sesame seeds and diced green onions and enjoy! 📩 Save this Crispy Asian Soy Glazed Chicken Meal Prep recipe to make for later and if you make it, post it and tag me in it! Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

This isn't a scene from a film. This is a heartbreaking reality that still exists in parts of Nepal. For some women and girls, getting their period means being sent away from their own home to spend the night in a small shed, away from their families. They are left to face cold nights, fear, loneliness, and the danger of snakes, insects, and wild animals—all because of a natural biological process. Menstruation should never be a reason for exclusion or shame. Take a moment and ask yourself: If it were someone you love—your daughter, your sister, your wife, or your mother—would you accept this as "tradition"? Some customs deserve to be questioned, especially when they put lives and dignity at risk. Every woman deserves to feel safe, respected, and valued, no matter what day of the month it is. Let's raise awareness, start conversations, and stand together to end harmful practices like this. Coming very soon, so follow my page so you don’t miss it Ingredients • 5 lb Yukon gold potatoes • 16 oz cream cheese, softened • ⅓ cup sour cream • ½ cup milk • 1 stick butter, softened, plus extra slices for topping • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp salt • Paprika, for topping • 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped Instructions 1. Set out the cream cheese and butter to soften. Preheat the oven to 400°F. 2. Boiling Method: Peel the potatoes and cut into evenly sized chunks. Place in a large pot, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 15–20 minutes, or until fork-tender. 3. Instant Pot Method (Alternative): Add 1 cup of water to the Instant Pot and place the trivet inside. Add the whole, unpeeled potatoes. Pressure cook on high for 14 minutes, then allow a 10-minute natural pressure release before releasing the remaining pressure. Carefully remove, cool slightly, and peel. Cook in batches if necessary. 4. Transfer cooked potatoes to a large mixing bowl. Add cream cheese, sour cream, milk, butter, salt, and pepper. 5. Use a hand mixer or stand mixer to mix until smooth and creamy, being careful not to overmix. 6. Transfer to a greased 9×13-inch baking dish and spread evenly. 7. Sprinkle paprika over the top and add a few thin slices of butter. 8. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. 9. Bake at 400°F for 60 minutes, or until heated through. 10. Remove the foil during the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 11. Sprinkle the freshly chopped chives over the top before serving. Make-Ahead Instructions 1. Prepare the mashed potatoes following steps 1–8 above, using either cooking method. Wait to preheat the oven until you’re ready to bake. 2. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate for up to 2 days. 3. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. 4. Preheat oven to 400°F. 5. Bake covered for approximately 60 minutes, until hot in the center. 6. Remove foil for the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 7. Sprinkle with the chopped chives before serving. #mashedpotatoes #EasyRecipe

Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍯🧀🍟 By far one of the best combos i’ve made, all made around making meal prepping easy and effortless. The chicken is absolutely INCREDIBLE! Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Season, spray generously with cooking spray and mix. Spread evenly and bake at 200C / 400F for 35-40 mins until golden and crispy. 3. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook 10 mins until softened, then add seasonings and fresh basil. 4. Toast 2 mins, then reduce heat to low. Add cream sauce, Parmesan and Parmesan rind. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. Serve and ENJOY! . . #garlicparmesan #healthyrecipes #mealprep #sheetpandinner #batchcooking

Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, and parsley. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove it and set aside with foil over it. 3. In the same pan, add olive oil. Add your diced onion and sauté about 3 minutes until soft. Keep stirring so it doesn’t burn. Then add butter & garlic and cook 30 seconds. 4. Pour in chicken broth to deglaze the pan. Stir in heavy cream, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 5 minutes. (Add cornstarch slurry if you want it thicker.) 5. Return chicken to the sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until fully cooked and tender. 6. Cook rice separately… bring liquid to a boil, add rinsed rice, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff. 7. Serve chicken over rice and spoon extra creamy sauce on top 🤍 #easydinner #dinnerinspo #easyrecipes #chickenandrice #chickenrecipes

videos.caption: CHINESE BEAUTY GLOW JELLY RECIPE ~ 100% natural. Nature’s collagen alternative ~ no refined sugar  I make these at @rawlalajuice check my stories Thursdays when I restock Snow Fungus, Asian Pear, Peach Gum, Red Jujube Date, Job’s Tears, Lily Bulb, Goji berry, Chrysanthemum, Honey  Recipe:  Makes 5 cups 1 litre water 1 handful peach gum 1 small handful snow fungus (about 10g) 2 tbsp Job’s tears 3 tbsp dried lily bulb 1 handful red dates 1 handful dried longan 2 Korean or Asian pears 1 small handful chrysanthemum flowers 1 handful goji berries Agave or Manila honey, to taste Pinch of sea salt Method:  NIGHT BEFORE Soak peach gum and Job’s tears in a big bowl of cold water. Peach gum swells 10x so go bigger than you think. Fridge, overnight. ON THE DAY 	1.	Drain the peach gum. Pick out any dark bark or grit. Rinse. 	2.	Soak lily bulb in cold water, fridge, 1 ~ 2 hours. 	3.	🔺Soak snow fungus cold water 30 ~ 1 hour NEVER leave in room temperature to soak overnight (can be dangerous!)  	4.	Cut the hard yellow core off the fungus. Tear the frills small. 	5.	Peel, core and quarter the pears. 	6.	Pot: peach gum, Job’s tears, snow fungus, pear, red dates, longan. Cover with water. 	7.	Boil, then lowest simmer, lid on, 1 hour. Stir every 20 mins so the Job’s tears don’t catch. 	8.	Add lily bulb. Chrysanthemum in a tea strainer. Simmer 8 mins, then lift the flowers out. 	9.	Off the heat: salt, goji, Manuka honey. Taste. More honey if you want. 	10.	Warm or chilled. It sets thicker overnight

videos.caption: Recipe Name: Creamy Spinach Mushroom Chicken Bake Ingredients 1. 6 boneless skinless chicken thighs or breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 1 tsp salt 4. 1 tsp black pepper 5. 1 tsp garlic powder 6. 8 oz mushrooms, sliced 7. 3 cups fresh spinach 8. 4 cloves garlic, minced 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded 12. 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese, grated 13. 1 tbsp butter 14. 1 tbsp chopped parsley Recipe 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Season chicken with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. 3. Sear chicken in olive oil until golden on both sides. 4. Transfer chicken to a baking dish. 5. Melt butter in the skillet and sauté mushrooms until browned. 6. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. 7. Stir in chicken broth and heavy cream. 8. Simmer for 3 minutes. 9. Add spinach and cook until wilted. 10. Pour sauce over chicken. 11. Top with mozzarella and Parmesan. 12. Bake 20–25 minutes until bubbly. 13. Broil 2 minutes for a golden top. 14. Garnish with parsley and serve. 👉 Follow our account for more delicious recipes every day!

Easy High Protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍯🍗🧀 59g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros Per Serve, Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Like recipes like this? Check out my cookbooks! LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! Store in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 3 to 4 days, or freeze individual portions for longer storage. #macandcheese #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes #chickenmacandcheese

Cross posting to 4 accounts has been a little crazy and ya girl needs a breather 😮‍💨 so enjoy! ☺️  ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 If comfort food had a personality, this would be it. Tender pan-seared chicken, creamy garlic parmesan gravy, and buttery mashed potatoes that soak up every last drop. ✨ 🕒 Total Time: ~45 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

Cozy & Affordable Baked Chicken Dinner 🍗🤎 Tonight I was going for cozy, comforting, and affordable, and this is one of my go-to dinners when I want something simple but still really good. Ingredients: * Chicken legs * Olive oil * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Seasoning salt * Black pepper * Italian seasoning * 1 orange bell pepper, sliced * 1 green bell pepper, sliced * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cans cream of mushroom soup * ½–1 cup chicken broth * Jasmine rice * French-style green beans * Buttermilk biscuits * Honey for glazing Instructions: 1. Season the chicken legs with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, seasoning salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and mix well so the seasoning coats the chicken. 3. Slice the peppers and onion. 4. Sauté the peppers and onions in a skillet until they begin to soften. 5. Add the cream of mushroom soup and chicken broth. Stir until smooth and creamy. 6. Place the seasoned chicken in a baking dish and pour the creamy mixture over the top. 7. Bake at 375°F for about 50–60 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally and is fully cooked. 8. Serve with jasmine rice, French-style green beans, and a warm buttermilk biscuit finished with a little honey. Affordable, filling, and the perfect comfort dinner. Save this one for later! 🤎 #BakedChicken #AffordableMeals #DinnerIdeas #ComfortFood #EasyRecipes

Sheet Pan BBQ Chicken & Braised Parmesan Cabbage 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs 2 yellow onions, sliced into ¼” rounds 3 russet potatoes, sliced into ¼” rounds Olive oil Salt and pepper BBQ sauce Slice onions and potatoes into ¼” rounds; toss with oil, salt, and pepper, then layer tightly on a sheet pan. Coat chicken in BBQ sauce and place on top. Roast at 400°F for 25–28 minutes, until cooked through. Remove chicken; broil vegetables 3–5 minutes to crisp. Return chicken, brush with more BBQ sauce, and broil 2–3 minutes until caramelized.  Braised Parmesan Cabbage 1 green cabbage, cut into 4 wedges Olive oil 2 tsp minced garlic 2 cups chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream 1½ cups freshly grated Parmesan, divided ⅓ cup minced chives Sear cabbage wedges in olive oil with salt over medium-high heat until well charred. Add garlic; sauté 1 minute. Pour in chicken broth and cream; bring to a simmer and cook 6–8 minutes, turning once. Sprinkle 1 cup Parmesan over cabbage and transfer to a 375°F oven; roast 10–15 minutes. Broil 1–2 minutes for a browned top.  Finish with remaining Parmesan and chives before serving. Crispy Chicken Thighs & Creamy Orzo 6–8 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs Salt Sear chicken skin-side down in olive oil over medium-high heat until crispy. Flip; cook 2–3 minutes more, then set aside. In the same pan, add: 3 tbsp butter 2 tbsp minced garlic 4 leeks, trimmed, halved lengthwise, thinly sliced Salt and pepper; sauté 5 minutes until softened. Stir in: 1 lb orzo (toast 2 minutes) 2 cups chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, nestle chicken on top skin-side up, and bake at 400°F for 15–20 minutes, until orzo is tender and chicken is cooked through.#mealprep #bulking #inseason #athletes #sheetpandinner @Smithey Ironware @Nordic Ware @SweetBabyRay

Season chicken: Pat chicken dry and season both sides with salt, pepper, and paprika. 	2.	Sear: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Simmer: Reduce heat to medium-low. Pour sauce into skillet. Spoon sauce over chicken and simmer 5–7 minutes until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through. 	5.	Serve: Spoon extra caramelized garlic sauce over top before serving. ⸻ 🍽️ Serve With 	•	White or jasmine rice 	•	Roasted broccoli 	•	Mashed potatoes ⸻ ✨ Tips 	•	Chicken thighs stay extra juicy 	•	For thicker sauce, simmer a few extra minutes 	•	Add a splash of pineapple juice for a sweet tropical twist Sticky, garlicky, and perfectly sweet — a guaranteed weeknight favorite 💛 #foodie #foodtok #recipe #dinner #chicken

Rest 10 minutes before slicing. 3️⃣ CREAMY KOREAN BULGOGI 🥩 Ingredients: Thinly sliced beef, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, sesame oil, heavy cream, green onions. Quick Recipe: Sear beef in batches until caramelized. Add soy sauce, garlic, sugar, and sesame oil. Stir in a splash of cream and simmer until silky. Finish with green onions and serve over rice. 2️⃣ SPINACH & FETA PASTRIES 🥬 Ingredients: Puff pastry, spinach, feta cheese, garlic, egg wash. Quick Recipe: Sauté spinach with garlic, then squeeze out excess moisture. Mix with feta, fill pastry squares, fold and seal. Brush with egg wash and bake at 400°F for 18–22 minutes until flaky and golden. 1️⃣ CHEESY PEPPERONI STROMBOLI 🧀🍕 Ingredients: Pizza dough, mozzarella cheese, pepperoni, Italian seasoning, egg wash, marinara sauce. Quick Recipe: Roll out pizza dough, layer with mozzarella and pepperoni, then roll tightly and seal. Cut small slits on top, brush with egg wash, and bake at 400°F for 20–25 minutes until golden. Slice and serve with warm marinara! 👩‍🍳 WANT THE FULL RECIPES? These are just the quick versions! Howlin’ Ray’s Nashville Hot Chicken at Home 🔥 Howlin’ Ray’s at Home Part 1/3 Send this to your mom so she can make it for you ❤️‍🔥 Comeback Sauce + Nashville Hot Chicken & Waffles recipes dropping SOON 😎 Full detailed recipes in bio 🔗 — CONDENSED RECIPE 👇 1️⃣ MARINATE: Pound 2 boneless chicken thighs to ½” thick. Whisk 2 cups buttermilk, ½ cup pickle juice, 2 tbsp hot sauce (@Osmo Kitchen magic sauce), 1 egg, kosher salt, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, paprika, white pepper, cayenne & optional MSG. Add thighs + 6 tenders, cover & refrigerate at least 4 hours, ideally overnight. 2️⃣ COMEBACK SAUCE: Mix mayo, ketchup, hot sauce, Dijon, Worcestershire, lemon juice, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper & salt. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. FULL RECIPE DROPPING SOON 🔥 3️⃣ DOUBLE DREDGE: Mix 3 cups flour, 1 cup cornstarch, 1 tbsp baking powder, kosher salt, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, paprika, white pepper, cayenne & optional MSG. Drizzle in 3–4 tbsp chicken marinade and mix to create craggly bits. Dip chicken in marinade → press into flour → rest on a rack for 10 minutes to hydrate flour → repeat marinade + flour before frying. 4️⃣ FRY: Heat neutral oil to 350°F. Fry in batches: tenders about 3–5 minutes; thighs about 5–7 minutes, until golden, CWISPY & 165°F internal. Drain on a clean wire rack. 5️⃣ NASHVILLE HOT OIL: In a heatproof bowl, combine cayenne, paprika, dark brown sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, black pepper, kosher salt & optional MSG. Carefully ladle in 1–1½ cups hot fry oil & whisk for 1-2 minutes to let bloom. Dunk or brush onto chicken. 6️⃣ SERVE: Enjoy with comeback sauce—or pile onto a buttered, toasted brioche bun with slaw, dill pickles & extra sauce. Serve immediately and enjoy, friends :) — #howlinrays #nashvillehotchicken #friedchicken #comebacksauce #recipe
